title: Upgrade Next.js to 16.2.11 for Jul 2026 security release
body: Resolved next@16.2.9 is vulnerable (<16.2.11). pnpm audit reports multiple High GHSAs (incl. rewrite SSRF / image-opt DoS). Fix: pnpm add next@16.2.11 --filter web; re-run pnpm audit.

title: Fix open redirect on /api/preview/exit
body: Unauthenticated GET accepts redirect= and passes it to new URL() then NextResponse.redirect, allowing absolute external URLs. Also harden /api/preview slug similarly. Fix: allow only same-origin relative paths starting with / and rejecting //.

title: Require Upstash for Oracle rate limits in production
body: Without UPSTASH_* env vars, rate limiting is per-process Map. On Vercel this multiplies the 10/hr budget across instances and resets on cold start — default spend-abuse path for ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Fix: fail closed in production if Upstash unset; document required env vars.

title: Harden Oracle: require Origin + bound message size
body: Origin check skipped when header absent; MessageSchema has no max length/count. Fix: reject missing Origin for POST; add zod .max on content and messages array.

title: Remove or lock down dead Hygraph preview/revalidate surface
body: Static-JSON app still ships preview/revalidate/hygraph API routes. Dead attack surface. Prefer delete unused routes per AGENTS.md data path.

title: Add HSTS (and tighten CSP when feasible)
body: headers() omit Strict-Transport-Security. Add HSTS max-age with includeSubDomains. CSP still has unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval (defense-in-depth gap).

title: Wire flagship Knowledge Quiz into ProgressContext
body: MythologyQuiz only writes mythos_quiz_highscore localStorage; quick/relationships quizzes update progress. Main /quiz completion does not affect XP/achievements/leaderboard. Fix: call progress APIs on completion like quiz/quick.

title: Fix resolveLocation to match slug like other entity resolvers
body: resolveLocation only checks location.id; deity/creature/artifact/story also match slug. GraphQL location(id: $slug) returns empty data. Fix: id === id || slug === id. Note: location App Router pages import locations.json directly (id-as-slug), so user-facing pages work; bug affects GraphQL API consumers only.

title: Move SEO prose below primary interactive content
body: Long SEO blocks sit above MythologyQuiz and bookmark grid, pushing core tasks below the fold especially on mobile.

title: Make pantheon detail theme-aware
body: Hardcoded midnight/parchment cards ignore ThemeProvider light mode used elsewhere.

title: Decide: full i18n for content pages OR stop implying locale coverage
body: LanguageSwitcher exists but marketing/legal/home content is English-only hardcoded; message keys for hero are orphaned. Either wire next-intl or narrow locale UX to Oracle/nav only and document that.

title: Replace everyone-ICP mission speak with a sharp learner job
body: About targets everyone. Pick study-loop ICP and rewrite hero/about to that job.

title: Align Oracle UI visibility with API readiness
body: Non-prod shows Oracle without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY → 503 on first message. Gate UI on same condition or surface a clear disabled state.

title: Break template features-grid + stock slate/amber deity hero
body: FeaturesGrid is generic icon-card SaaS pattern; deity hero uses slate/amber not brand tokens.

title: Prefer platform IP helper over raw X-Forwarded-For
body: Skeptic downgraded spoof risk on Vercel (platform overwrites XFF) but pattern is still fragile if hosting changes. Use request IP from platform API.

title: Short-circuit background sync when no service worker
body: PWA/SW disabled but registerBackgroundSync awaits navigator.serviceWorker.ready which never settles. Fix: return early unless an active registration exists.

title: Remove false offline claim from install prompt
body: InstallPrompt promises offline reading but next-pwa is a no-op. Remove offline copy until SW returns, or re-enable PWA.

title: Triage full-tree gitleaks noise; keep .history out of scans
body: Full-tree --no-git gitleaks reported 49 leaks over ~5GB (likely .history/node_modules). apps/web/src clean. Ensure .history is gitignored and excluded from secret scans; spot-check any tracked hits.
fix: Exclude noise paths; verify no tracked secrets
